title: Oil Climbs as Houthis Declare Maritime Blockade on Saudi Arabia, Attack Two Tankers
summary: Houthi militants declared a full maritime embargo on Saudi Arabia after attacking tankers Encelia and Layla in the Red Sea, threatening over 4 million barrels of daily Saudi crude flow. Brent crude advanced near $96/bbl.
why: 油价冲击全球通胀预期，可能影响美联储降息节奏；若Brent突破100美元，全球风险偏好下移，持仓波动率上升，sell put需上调保护线。

title: Alphabet Q2 Revenue +24% Beats, But Capex Doubles to $44.9B; Full-Year Guidance Raised to $195-205B
summary: Alphabet Q2 revenue rose 24% to $119.8B with Google Cloud surging 82% to $24.8B, but capex more than doubled to $44.9B pushing free cash flow to -$5.9B. Full-year 2026 capex guidance raised to $195-205B with 2027 expected to rise further. GOOGL stock sank.
why: 谷歌是AI基础设施需求最权威风向标；天量资本开支令市场担忧AI泡沫回调，但云端82%增速亦确认需求真实；英伟达/SK海力士受益链逻辑不变。GOOGL仓位覆盖call需重评时机。

title: Tesla Q2 Revenue +26%, But Operating Margin Collapses to 1.4%; Robotaxi Expands to 7 Cities
summary: Tesla Q2 revenue rose 26% to $28.24B, but operating margin fell sharply to 1.4% from 4.1% a year ago as operating expenses surged 47% on AI and R&D spending. Robotaxi now in 7 metro areas; Optimus production lines being installed at Fremont factory.
why: 特斯拉利润率大幅压缩，短期sell put策略需关注下行压力；Robotaxi扩城及Optimus生产线落地为长期看多逻辑提供支撑，两者分歧仍大。

title: Asian Chipmakers Lead Regional Rally; KOSPI +2.8% as AI Buildout Capex Confirms Demand
summary: MSCI Asia Pacific climbed 1%, led by South Korean chip stocks — Samsung and SK Hynix both gained more than 3% — as investors bet AI infrastructure spending will remain robust following Alphabet's record $195-205B full-year capex guidance.
why: AI资本开支景气信号确认，直接利好持仓SK海力士（7709.HK）及南方两倍做多ETF；港股科技整体情绪升温，看好现有仓位。

title: Super Micro Discloses Record $60B AI Server Backlog; Gross Margin Guidance Doubles to 15-17%
summary: Super Micro announced Q4 FY2026 received over $60B in new orders, pushing backlog to a record. Gross margin guidance raised to 15-17% from prior ~8.4% on favorable customer mix. Stock surged 22%+; Dell gained 9%, HPE +5% on AI server read-through.
why: AI服务器需求景气确认，利好英伟达GPU供应链；大盘情绪指标，关注持仓NVDA期权行权价是否需要上移。

title: 花旗将中国股市评级上调至超配，恒指2026年底目标29600点
summary: 花旗集团正式将中国股市由战术性中性上调至超配，设恒生指数2026年底目标价29600点、沪深300目标5600点；渣打银行及高盛同步维持超配评级，共同理由为中国宏观韧性及AI、生物科技领域创新吸引力。
why: 外资机构集体看多港股，有利于持有腾讯、阿里、美团等港股核心仓位；整体Beta提升，关注外资流入落地节奏对仓位影响。

title: 证监会召开系列座谈会稳定A股市场预期，国有资本及机构投资者集结维稳
summary: A股出现较大波动后，证监会召开系列座谈会稳定市场预期；两大国有资本运营公司、上市公司及机构投资者纷纷出手维稳。花旗、渣打、高盛同步看多中国股票。
why: 政策底信号明确，A股短期下行空间受限；若稳市力量持续入市，有利于A股相关持仓（好未来等）及降低sell put被行权概率。

title: 中际旭创启动港股招股，拟募资约70亿美元，为年内港股最大IPO
summary: 光互连龙头中际旭创7月22日启动香港公开发售，最高发行价1,010港元，预计7月30日于港交所主板挂牌，募资规模约545亿港元（约70亿美元）。35%资金用于光互连研发，30%用于产能扩充，连续五年全球最大光互连解决方案提供商。
why: 港股年内最大IPO，AI光模块赛道估值标杆；上市首日可能引发资金再平衡，关注持仓港股科技板块联动。

title: Alibaba Qwen AI Wins Approval to Power Apple Intelligence in China; BABA Stock Surges ~5%
summary: Alibaba's Qwen AI models received regulatory approval to power Apple Intelligence and Siri in mainland China, making Alibaba a core AI supplier to Apple's local ecosystem. Stock rose ~5% to ~$120; Morgan Stanley keeps Overweight with $180 target on AI cloud triple-digit growth.
why: 阿里云价值重估核心催化剂：通义千问成为苹果中国AI基础设施，验证云计算变现逻辑；看好BABA长期持仓，阿里云估值溢价有望重新定价。

title: 金价半年跌超28%，老铺黄金市值较历史高点蒸发逾1200亿港元，门店冷清估值回落至12倍PE
summary: 现货黄金较年初高点5,598美元/盎司下跌逾28%至约4,018美元，老铺黄金（6181.HK）股价较历史高点跌超65%，估值从50倍PE压缩至约12倍，门店客流锐减，部分门店改售按克计价产品，东方硬奢模式遭遇严峻考验。
why: 老铺黄金高溢价核心逻辑动摇：金价超预期下跌削弱情感消费动能；持仓者需重评支撑价位，sell put行权风险上升，建议上调保护价格。

title: Circle Becomes First Licensed Stablecoin Bank After OCC Federal Trust Charter; CRCL +8%
summary: Circle Internet Group received OCC approval to operate as a national trust bank, the first stablecoin issuer with a federal banking charter. USDC circulation grew 19% to $73.2B; Standard Chartered activated institutional minting and redemption. Stock gained 8%.
why: 监管里程碑消除Circle最大合规风险，联邦银行牌照构建竞争护城河；USDC流通量增长稳固收入基础，Circle仓位长期逻辑增强。

title: SK Hynix Surges 14% Ahead of July 29 Earnings; Q2 Operating Profit Seen +556% YoY on HBM Demand
summary: SK Hynix shares jumped 14% to $172.80 in Seoul ahead of July 29 quarterly results. Analysts project Q2 operating profit of ~60.4 trillion won (+556% YoY). Key debate: whether HBM4 volume shipments materialized as expected in Q2.
why: SK海力士是核心持仓（7709.HK及南方两倍做多），Q2业绩直接影响股价；HBM4发货量是关键变量，若低于预期则短期回调风险上升，需检视sell put行权价安全边际。

title: Intel Reports Q2 2026 Earnings After Close Today; Up 163% YTD With Options Pricing 15% Move
summary: Intel (INTC) reports Q2 2026 financial results July 23 after market close. Consensus: revenue $14.4B, EPS $0.10. Stock is up 163% YTD on 18A process progress and data-center growth; options market pricing approximately a 15% move.
why: 英特尔是持仓标的，财报将验证18A制程进展及代工业务前景；上涨163%后估值压力大，业绩若不达预期则回调风险显著；有covered call策略需关注行权节点。

title: 小米汽车7月推出YU7购车权益，雷军预告澎湃增程技术或开辟新赛道
summary: 小米汽车公布7月购车权益：YU7享6,500元科技套装限时优惠及3,000元车漆券；SU7系列首付仅4.99万元。雷军7月17日发文预告澎湃增程技术，小米汽车或即将推出增程车型。
why: 增程路线预告为小米汽车开辟新市场提供想象空间；持续价格激励显示渗透竞争加剧，关注1810.HK汽车业务估值贡献节点。
url: https://hk.finance.yahoo.com/news/简讯-小米正式发布yu7-起售价25-35万元-044231872.html

title: EU July 1 Package Fee Squeezes Temu and Shein; PDD Revenue Growth Slows to Single Digits
summary: EU's new €3/package customs fee effective July 1 eliminates the prior €150 duty-free threshold, directly hitting Temu, Shein, and AliExpress. Combined with US de minimis loss, PDD Holdings revenue growth has decelerated to single digits from 59% in 2024.
why: 拼多多Temu跨境电商模式遭中美欧三边监管压制，国际业务增长逻辑受损；PDD持仓者需重估增长预期，sell put下方保护需警惕基本面拐点。
